subject: math
l2: 曲面积分与高斯斯托克斯
question: 计算曲面积分 $\iint_{S} \frac{ax \, \mathrm{d}y \, \mathrm{d}z + (z + a)^2 \, \mathrm{d}x \, \mathrm{d}y}{(x^2 + y^2 + z^2)^{\frac{1}{2}}}$ ，其中 $S$ 为下半球面 $z = -\sqrt{a^2 - x^2 - y^2}$ 的上侧， $a$ 为大于零的常数.

steps.text: 分析 将曲面 S 的方程代入积分式的分母，使积分式化简，再做计算.

将曲面方程 $x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} = a^{2}$ 代入积分式的分母，有

$$
I = \iint_ {S} \frac {a x \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z + (z + a) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y}{\left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} + z ^ {2}\right) ^ {\frac {1}{2}}} = \frac {1}{a} \iint_ {S} a x \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z + (z + a) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y.
$$

下面用 3 种方法计算.

方法1 补一有向圆片 $S_{1}: z = 0 (x^{2} + y^{2} \leqslant a^{2})$ ，取下侧，设 $S$ 与 $S_{1}$ 所围立体为 $\Omega$ ，如图6.9所示，由高斯公式得

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\iint_ {S + S _ {1}} a x \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z + (z + a) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = - \iiint_ {\Omega} (3 a + 2 z) \mathrm{d} V} \\ & {= - 3 a \iiint_ {\Omega} \mathrm{d} V - 2 \iiint_ {\Omega} z \mathrm{d} V = - 3 a \left(\frac {2}{3} \pi a ^ {3}\right) - 2 \int_ {- a} ^ {0} z \mathrm{d} z \iint_ {D (z)} \mathrm{d} \sigma} \\ & {= - 2 \pi a ^ {4} - 2 \pi \int_ {- a} ^ {0} z (a ^ {2} - z ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} z \qquad (D (z): x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} = a ^ {2} - z ^ {2})} \\ & {= - 2 \pi a ^ {4} - 2 \pi \cdot \left(- \frac {1}{4} a ^ {4}\right) = - \frac {3}{2} \pi a ^ {4}.} \end{array}
$$

图6.9

对平面 $S_{1}$ 的积分用分面投影法，因为平面 $S_{1}$ 垂直于坐标面 yOz， $S_{1}$ 取下侧，所以有

$$
\begin{array}{l} \iint_ {S _ {1}} a x \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z + (z + a) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = 0 + \iint_ {S _ {1}} (z + a) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = - a ^ {2} \iint_ {D _ {x y}} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = - \pi a ^ {4}. \\ I = \frac {1}{a} \left(\oiint_ {S + S _ {1}} - \iint_ {S _ {1}}\right) a x \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z + (z + a) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \frac {1}{a} \left[ - \frac {3}{2} \pi a ^ {4} - (- \pi a ^ {4}) \right] = - \frac {1}{2} \pi a ^ {3}. \end{array}
$$

方法2 用分面投影法计算 $I = \frac{1}{a}\iint_{S}ax\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}z + (z + a)^2\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$

设 $S$ 的前半球面为 $S_{\text{前}}: x = \sqrt{a^2 - y^2 - z^2}$ （后侧）， $S$ 的后半球面为 $S_{\text{后}}: x = -\sqrt{a^2 - y^2 - z^2}$ （前侧），则

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\frac {1}{a} \iint_ {S} a x \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z = \iint_ {S} x \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z = \iint_ {S _ {\text {前}}} x \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z + \iint_ {S _ {\text {后}}} x \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z} \\ & {\qquad = \iint_ {D _ {y z}} \sqrt {a ^ {2} - y ^ {2} - z ^ {2}} (- \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z) + \iint_ {D _ {y z}} (- \sqrt {a ^ {2} - y ^ {2} - z ^ {2}}) \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z} \\ & {\qquad = - 2 \iint_ {D _ {y z}} \sqrt {a ^ {2} - y ^ {2} - z ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z \qquad (D _ {y z}: y ^ {2} + z ^ {2} \leqslant a ^ {2}, z \leqslant 0)} \\ & {\qquad = - 2 \int_ {- \pi} ^ {0} \mathrm{d} \varphi \int_ {0} ^ {a} \sqrt {a ^ {2} - \rho^ {2}} \rho \mathrm{d} \rho = - \frac {2}{3} \pi a ^ {2}.} \end{array}

\frac {1}{a} \iint_ {S} (z + a) ^ {2} d x d y = \frac {1}{a} \iint_ {D _ {x y}} \left(a - \sqrt {a ^ {2} - x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}}\right) ^ {2} d x d y \quad \left(D _ {x y}: x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant a ^ {2}\right)

= \frac {1}{a} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} d \varphi \int_ {0} ^ {a} (a - \sqrt {a ^ {2} - \rho^ {2}}) ^ {2} \rho d \rho = \frac {\pi}{6} a ^ {3}.
$$

故

$$
I = \frac {1}{a} \iint_ {S} a x d y d z + (z + a) ^ {2} d x d y = - \frac {2}{3} \pi a ^ {3} + \frac {\pi}{6} a ^ {3} = - \frac {\pi}{2} a ^ {3}.
$$

方法 3 合一投影法.

积分 $I = \frac{1}{a}\iint_{S}ax\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}z + (z + a)^2\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$ 对应的向量值函数为 $\pmb {F} = (ax,0,(z + a)^2)$ ，曲面 $S:z = -\sqrt{a^2 - x^2 - y^2}$ 的上侧法向量为

$$
\boldsymbol {n} = \left(- \frac {\partial z}{\partial x}, - \frac {\partial z}{\partial y}, 1\right) = \left(\frac {- x}{\sqrt {a ^ {2} - x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}}}, \frac {- y}{\sqrt {a ^ {2} - x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}}}, 1\right).
$$

$S$ 在 $xOy$ 面的投影区域为 $D_{xy}: x^2 + y^2 \leqslant a^2$ ，则

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {I = \frac {1}{a}  \iint_ {S} F \cdot \mathrm{d} S = \frac {1}{a}  \iint_ {D _ {x y}} F [ x, y, z (x, y) ] \cdot n   \mathrm{d} x   \mathrm{d} y} \\ & {\qquad = \frac {1}{a}  \iint_ {D _ {x y}} \left(\frac {- a x ^ {2}}{\sqrt {a ^ {2} - x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}}} + (a - \sqrt {a ^ {2} - x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}}) ^ {2}\right) \mathrm{d} x   \mathrm{d} y} \\ & {\underline {{{\underline {{{\text {极坐标}}}}}}} \frac {1}{a}  \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm{d} \varphi  \int_ {0} ^ {a} \left(\frac {- a \rho^ {2} \cos^ {2} \varphi}{\sqrt {a ^ {2} - \rho^ {2}}} + (a - \sqrt {a ^ {2} - \rho^ {2}}) ^ {2}\right) \rho   \mathrm{d} \rho} \\ & {\qquad = \frac {1}{a} \bigg (- \frac {2}{3} a ^ {4} \pi + \frac {1}{6} a ^ {4} \pi \bigg) = - \frac {1}{2} a ^ {3} \pi .} \end{array}
$$

cdps.prompt: 宜用合一投影、分面投影还是参数化？法向符号如何取？
cdps.expected: 选定投影/参数化路线，写出含法向符号的二重积分。

meta.commentary:
评注（1）利用曲面方程化简积分表达式是计算中常用的方法。本题的方法1中若不先将分母化简，就不能用高斯公式，因为积分在平面 $S_{1}$ 上有奇点(0,0).

(2) 曲面积分要根据积分式的特点合理选择计算方法。一般说来，若积分式为多项（至少两项），而曲面又不是平面或柱面，则不适宜选分面投影法计算。
